question: How do filters work on search results?
answer: Use the filters on the results screen to narrow matches without re-running your query. Available filters include Name, Date (custom date range), Period Type, and Results (match result). Filters apply to all query types except Streaks.

question: How do filters work on search results?
answer: Refine results from the sidebar without retyping your query. Sidebar filters apply to all query types except Streaks and include opponent and conference, game result (wins or losses), game type (regular or post-season), date range, player metadata (name, position, class year), and period type (such as first half or overtime).
